title: NoFap is a meme and you fell for it
summary: A three-hour thesis arguing NoFap is a 4chan meme that disguises a spiritual practice (mortification) as a testosterone/gains hack; it does not durably raise testosterone, makes men more obsessed with and resentful of women, and is part of the chronic-masturbation cycle. He argues the real enemy is porn and hypersexualized social media, and prescribes controlled, imagination-only masturbation plus quitting porn (NoPorn) instead of renouncing libido.
claims: NoFap as an internet practice started as a joke meme on 4chan's /fit/ board; he says he was there when it began and most posters were not doing it themselves
NoFap is really a spiritual idea disguised as a physical-benefits package and spread as a meme, which is why men are so drawn to it
About half of men do NoFap believing masturbation lowers testosterone and slows muscle gains; this is an old myth going back to Greek athletes and coaches banning release before competition
Studies on boxers show sex before a fight does not hurt performance, and sex the day before may even raise testosterone
Feeling horny and aggressive when abstaining is not the same as having elevated testosterone; men confuse the mental state with an anabolic one
Testosterone dips for roughly an hour after ejaculation then returns to baseline; abstinence gives a brief rise, then levels fall back to normal or lower as the body gives up
Speculatively, frequent ejaculation could signal the body to produce more testosterone, while abstinence could teach it to be less anabolic (unproven theory)
The energy and confidence boost people feel on NoFap is mostly just recovery from chronic over-masturbation, not a real benefit of abstinence
The deeper motivation for NoFap is women: men want energy and confidence to approach them, so it is a disguised mating strategy
Women sense sexual desperation and are repelled by it; a pent-up man on NoFap comes across as creepy rather than mysterious
Neither chronic masturbation nor total abstinence works; NoFap and chronic masturbation are two halves of one cycle of streaks and relapses
Renouncing your libido means you can no longer control it; real manhood is keeping the sex drive under control, neither letting it run rampant nor denying it
Wet dreams prove the body will force release; treating them as betrayal and doubling down means treating your own body as the enemy
Calling a return to masturbation a 'relapse' borrows drug-addiction language and shows the sex drive has been demonized
Many young men are starved of human touch; NoFap symbolically refuses self-touch in protest at not being touched by anyone else
Being a virgin is no shame; don't rush to lose virginity to anyone, wait for someone who means something to you, and expect the first time to be underwhelming
When horny, men become less selective and make bad decisions; he says his IQ feels divided by three
NoFap communities breed resentment and hatred of women because the practice hinges on women and fails to deliver them
NoFap is a form of mortification, the sacrifice of biological drives for spiritual gain as monks do, which young men never knowingly signed up for
Boredom masturbation is like boredom snacking; instead channel the restless energy into productive acts such as training, writing, building or helping someone
Stopping and restarting an addiction is worse than never stopping, because it teaches your brain you cannot quit
Modern men face far more sexual stimuli than their grandfathers; this hypersexualized environment, not masturbation itself, created the need for NoFap
Early exposure to porn at 10-11, before a boy's first masturbation, badly damages his future sexuality and relationships; he discovered porn at 14-15 and used it from 16-17
Semen retention is nonsense: semen does not accumulate as vitality, and he speculates it may have been a 4chan prank that could harm prostate health
Some studies link frequent ejaculation (about 21 times a month) to lower prostate cancer risk, while others find the opposite, so he falls back on logic that periodic release is healthy

On Instagram he only follows male fitness pages yet the explore feed always shows a sexualized woman; he feels the urge to click but never does, and men should treat such posts as an aggression and refuse to click
Female fitness YouTube channels with mostly male audiences are largely watched for sexual reasons rather than for training advice
Every click on sexualized content trains the algorithm to target other men, so men are engineering their own destruction
Masturbation is acceptable if you control it: frequency is individual (twice a week or every two days), done only to release excess energy that stops you being productive, never as a sex substitute
Porn, not masturbation, is the real problem; it is more addictive than steroids or stimulants and almost every man who has consumed it is hooked to some degree
Porn devolves sexual taste over time from soft to extreme content, both across a session and over years
He quit porn largely because of what he was seeing on porn sites, which disgusted him
Sex is the opposite of masturbation: masturbation drains his energy while sex leaves him energized, pumped and confident
Conclusion: masturbate sparingly using only imagination, never sexual media; quit porn today; NoPorn is realistic where NoFap is not
Social media is to women what porn is to men, both hijacking evolved drives for attention and sex
